page.content:
Jiro's basement counter in Ginza, a pilgrimage omakase.

How Sukiyabashi Jiro connects

  • Character: Jiro Ono — Jiro Ono is the founding itamae of Sukiyabashi Jiro.
  • Location: Tokyo — Sukiyabashi Jiro is a Ginza counter in Tokyo.

What is Sukiyabashi Jiro?

Sukiyabashi Jiro is the tiny Ginza shop where Ono and his sons served a fixed sequence of nigiri, later a Michelin and film landmark.

Key threads lead to Jiro Ono and Tokyo.
